top_choice_rationale: P002 pairs two game-changers with real consequences within three names: base editing (a deaminase directed to a chosen base without a double-strand break, reproduced widely and now clinical) credited to Liu as originator of both editor classes, and targeted protein degradation credited to Crews (bifunctional ligase recruitment) and Handa (cereblon as the mechanism of thalidomide-type glues, already medicine). Each part has a short, accurate citation. Costs I accept: Kondo and Nishida remain a precursor risk, base editing is about ten years old, and Deshaies, Ciulli, Sakamoto and Gray are left out.
